ref: ADR-0025 Families and the amendment of 2026-11-03 (text is code points; Q10: a malformed number is err:FORG0001 at the box); ADR-0026 (a function with a deviation has no assumed case)
note: ADR-0025 "Families" and the amendment of 2026-11-03: text counts, indexes and orders in code points, not UTF-16 units; a character outside the BMP is a catalogue deviation. start 1 length 2 takes two code points, the emoji and b (UTF-16 would take the two units of the emoji only).
